lockFileMaintenance.description: lockFileMaintenance upgrades carry no release timestamp, so renovate/stability-days can never pass and the PR sits pending forever. The age floor is still enforced on the lockfile itself by pnpm's minimumReleaseAge (pnpm-workspace.yaml), which covers transitive deps too.

packageRules.description: vue2 pnpm catalog tracks the Vue 2 line; never propose major bumps (e.g. @vue/test-utils v1 → v2 is a Vue 3 release).
vue-2 alias in the vue3 catalog is the Vue 2 peer used for cross-version tests; pin to the v2 major.
